exposure: grand-multiparous women with and without one previous cesarean delivery
number of previous vaginal deliveries after cesarean delivery
number of previous successful vaginal deliveries after a CD
cohort: 2815 grand-multiparous women with singleton pregnancy at term who had a trial of vaginal delivery
finding: Grand-multiparous women with and without a previous cesarean delivery had comparable pregnancy outcomes, including successful vaginal delivery rates, and having one previous successful vaginal birth after cesarean significantly increased the odds of achieving another vaginal birth in a subsequent trial of labor.
mod_finding: Grand-multiparous women with and without previous cesarean delivery have comparable pregnancy outcomes.
